question: Which of the following is an inland riverine port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kolkata port is an** inland riverine port **because this port is located on **the Hugli river**.
 
• This port is developed by** the British. **
 
• Kolkata Port is also confronted with the problem of **silt accumulation** in the Hugli river which provides a link to the sea.
 
• This port** lost its significance** because of silt accumulation.
